ownerStatement: Phase 4.3a A3 için OWNER ACCEPTED, kaydet
scope: Phase 4.3a A3, the guarded capture client for sinbad-answer, exactly as merged at that commit and tree: sinbad-ai-core/shadow/capture-client.js, tools/capture-sinbad-answer.js, tests/sinbad-shadow-capture-client.test.js, docs/project2/PHASE_4_3A_A3_CAPTURE_CLIENT.md. A tool the Owner runs that sends the fixed gold prompt set once each to the cloud function and writes sinbad-shadow-capture-record/0-v1 records, the format the A2 evaluator reads, outside the repository. Guards accepted with it: dry run by default; --execute only with --confirm-cloud-calls equal to --max-calls; a ceiling below the prompt count refused, never truncated; hosts limited to https supabase.co (loopback http only for tests); one call per prompt, sequential, spaced, no retry, no web search or visual options; stops on 401/403, 429, a non-privileged caller or three consecutive errors; credentials only from the environment, never stored or printed, a response that echoes one withheld; output outside the repository, created exclusively. Built as SINBAD TASK-7 through the accepted Participation Gate. Also accepted: the lifecycle evidence recorded for TASK-7 (PR linked, merge verified, post-merge CI verified, COMPLETED), recorded forward, not retroactively.

postMergeReleaseQuality.attempt1: cancelled: the 15 minute job timeout was reached during the browser tests (the Chromium install alone took about 7 minutes); every earlier step, including the full regression suite, succeeded
postMergeReleaseQuality.attempt2: success, after an Owner-authorized re-run of that run (13 minutes 22 seconds)
postMergeReleaseQuality.observation: the job timeout leaves little margin; this is a CI infrastructure observation, not evidence about PR 317, and the workflow file was not changed

evidence.testReconciliation: local npm test 2506 tests = 2503 pass + 2 fail (known local-only CRLF hash tests) + 1 skipped (Docker unavailable); the 9 tests added by PR 317 all pass
evidence.mutationEvidence: ten deliberate mutants of the client each made a test fail; a test restructure ensures a failing assertion can no longer leave the mock server open

ledger.note: The ledger lives outside the repository; these hashes identify the events so the record can be checked against it. The pre-merge CI run is documented here, not in the ledger, because the lifecycle capability models post-merge CI only.

notIncluded.realCapture: no capture was ever taken; the client has only talked to a loopback mock written for the tests
notIncluded.cloudCallOrCredentials: none was made or used; running the client (A5) needs its own Owner decision: call ceiling, whose credentials, who runs it
notIncluded.unmeasuredAgainstTheRealFunction: how the real function answers, how often the model writes [S#] markers, real latency, cost and rate limits are unmeasured
notIncluded.wiringOrProductionChange: none; the client is run by hand and wired nowhere, and no npm script or workflow starts it
notIncluded.statedLimits: it captures what a privileged caller sees; the prompt set is the gold prompts, not real traffic; accepted as stated limits
notIncluded.ciTimeoutMargin: the Release quality job timeout is narrow; the workflow file is ARGOS-protected and unchanged, changing it is a separate decision
notIncluded.project2State: docs/project2/PROJECT2_STATE.json is not changed; recording Phase 4.3a A3 in the Project 2 state is a separate decision

standingOwnerDoctrine: SINBAD FIRST. SINBAD ALWAYS IN THE LOOP. Recording this acceptance was itself routed through the Participation Gate as TASK-8.
